title: Chanan of Gufta
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:2 he said before Shmuel that Rav Chiyya bar Ashi did not act so; he said to him, etc. In Orlah 3:7, Shmuel fined Chanan Guvita for uprooting mixed plantings.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 5:2 reads Chanin miGuftiyyah, beside Hyman's Chanan form, and records his statement before Shmuel about Rav Chiyya bar Ashi. Orlah 3:7 reads Chanin Govita: he uproots another person's barley-and-turnip planting, and Shmuel penalizes him. The different forms remain alongside Hyman's identification, without independently joining their identities or importing a legal ruling.
